title: Candidate recall, not verification, limits LLM structure elucidation from real experimental IR and NMR: IRexp dataset, IRSpectra-Bench, and forward-verification code
description: Open data and code for the manuscript "Candidate recall, not verification, limits LLM structure elucidation from real experimental IR and NMR." Includes IRexp (121,233 experimental-IR records; 43,060 structure-linked; 33,201 full IR + 1H + 13C + structure quadruples), the blind IRSpectra-Bench benchmark (194 compounds) and its battery-electrolyte subset, model predictions, the forward-verification and HOSE-code verifier code, and all figure/scoring/mining scripts. Spectra are redistributed under their source licences (PMC Open-Access Subset, CC-BY-4.0; Chemotion/RADAR4Chem, CC-BY-SA-4.0), kept as separable pools; each record carries its source DOI/accession for attribution. Code is released under the MIT License (see LICENSE). NOTE: the held-out expert-audit and modality answer keys are intentionally excluded; the 152 MB nmrshiftdb2.sd snapshot and the built hose_c13.json.gz HOSE table are uploaded as separate files because they are not tracked in the GitHub repository.
